nodes.statement: Real Euclidean coordinates, Euclidean norm, identity matrices; A≼B means B−A positive semidefinite.
O(n)={O∈R^(n×n): OᵀO=I_n}. O is real orthogonal, without a determinant-sign restriction.
A_(d,κ) consists of real symmetric precision matrices with I_d≼A≼κI_d; source convention d≥1, κ≥1.
For each admissible input A the centered Gaussian target is π_A=N(0,A⁻¹). Precision is A and covariance is A⁻¹.
κ≥4, 3≤n≤d, and k=⌊d/n⌋. The fixed-tuple law does not assume n is odd or n=2T+1.
An arbitrary tuple (O₁,…,O_k)∈O(n)^k. Individual signs and block matrices may differ.
A_𝐎=diag(A_(O₁),…,A_(O_k),I_(d−kn)), in contiguous block coordinates.
If kn=d, omit the identity block and final Gaussian factor; a formal Fin 0 residual realizes this through the unique zero-dimensional probability factor.
The symmetric part (O+Oᵀ)/2 has spectrum in [−1,1]; the Eq4 affine transform gives [1,κ]; block diagonal and identity blocks preserve the bounds. This is a summary with the printed proof in B.3.
For every O∈O(n), v∈R^n, orthogonality gives ‖Ov‖=‖v‖; Cauchy–Schwarz gives |⟨v,Ov⟩|≤‖v‖².
|⟨u,v⟩|≤‖u‖‖v‖ on real Euclidean space. Named in the source at its actual use site.
A_O=A_Oᵀ and ‖v‖²≤vᵀA_Ov≤κ‖v‖², hence I_n≼A_O≼κI_n.
Write x=(x₁,…,x_k,z) with x_j∈R^n and z∈R^(d−kn); apply Eq26 to each block.
‖x‖²=Σ_j‖x_j‖²+‖z‖²≤Σ_j x_jᵀA_(O_j)x_j+‖z‖²=xᵀA_𝐎x≤κΣ_j‖x_j‖²+‖z‖²≤κ‖x‖². Uses κ≥1 and omits z terms if kn=d. A_𝐎 is symmetric, so A_𝐎∈A_(d,κ).
The precision-class membership part of Lemma3.4/LemmaB.8: for every fixed 𝐎∈O(n)^k, A_𝐎∈A_(d,κ). Unique minimizer clauses are covered but excluded from this target.
For fixed b∈{−1,+1}, sample O_j independently from μ_(n,b), the Haar law conditioned on det O=b; D_b is the pushforward law of A_𝐎. This is later averaging data, absent from the sealed root.
P_b=E_(O∼μ_(n,b))[N(0,A_O⁻¹)]. This generally is a mixture, distinct from each fixed individual Gaussian.
The source explicitly asserts π̄_b=E_(A∼D_b)[π_A]=P_b^(⊗k)⊗N(0,I_(d−kn)). It does not print a fixed-tuple factorization proof here.
B.2.3 invokes Eq6 to write p̄_b(x₁,…,x_k,z)=∏_j p_b(x_j) φ_(d−kn)(z) for kn<d. Actual density identification is a separate consumer obligation.
For kn=d, the later affinity identity uses the same formula with the Gaussian factor omitted. It does not create a public assumption r>0.

With k=d/n and r=d%n, prove kn+r=d and that the exact sealed e implements contiguous blocks: e(inl(i,j)) has numeric coordinate j*n+i and e(inr(t)) has numeric coordinate k*n+t. Prove the sealed split is the actual continuous measurable linear coordinate isomorphism. No private-name access or replacement e is authorized.
